system.description:
A small and easily concealable firearm. Gain +1DM to conceal this weapon if needed.

Short Arms Ammo: each round costs 5cr and weighs 10g.

Traits

  • Conceal: This weapon can be concealed easily, granting +1DM when attempting to hide the weapon.

This weapon is a one-handed firearm capable of auto-fire.

Short Arms Ammo: each round costs 5cr and weighs 10g.

Traits

  • Auto 2: Can be fired at a number of different targets during the same combat round, equal to the Auto number; always fires this amount of rounds. Multiple targets: -1DM per interval of Auto. Single target: the Auto number is added as damage on a hit. Suppression: +DM equal to the Auto number.

The revolver is an older but reliable firearm. Ignore weapon-jamming if a 2 is rolled on an attack.

Short Arms Ammo: each round costs 5cr and weighs 10g.

Traits

  • Reliable: Ignore weapon-jamming if a 2 is rolled on an attack.
  • Spread: Can use Spread ammo: decrease effective range by one range band; -1DM per target in range, damage split evenly between the targets hit.

Similar to a body pistol but is designed to be used in low gravity situations by preventing recoil.

Short Arms Ammo: each round costs 5cr and weighs 10g.

Traits

  • Zero-G: Prevents recoil, allowing use in low-to-no gravity without incurring penalties to attacks due to drifting.

This weapon accelerates the round using electromagnetic power to provide more damage.

Short Arms Ammo: each round costs 5cr and weighs 10g.

Traits

  • Piercing 1: Reduces the Armour of the target by the listed number, to a minimum of 8+ to hit.
